ValidationRule.description: #28487-Account: Create 'At-Risk' fields to capture necessary details of the new At-Risk process #30729: New At-Risk fields can only be edited when Hierarchy Level = Sales (Site)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Account'))),
NOT(ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Sales (Site)')),
OR( AND( ISNEW(), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(At_Risk_Status_New__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(At_Risk_Reason_Code__c))), NOT(ISBLANK((At_Risk_Comments__c))) ) ), OR( ISCHANGED(At_Risk_Status_New__c), ISCHANGED(At_Risk_Reason_Code__c), ISCHANGED(At_Risk_Comments__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Sale (Site) Accounts can only be marked 'At-Risk', please update at the Child level
